ns2:course.label: Art-Centered Learning at the Secondary Level
ns2:course.description: Focusing on contemporary art and integration with other disciplines, students will design lesson plans and curriculum for secondary students. Observations and teaching of lessons will occur in local junior/high school art rooms. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTE 301 or junior standing in art, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTE 301 or junior standing in art, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
